scope.outcome: Make Command Center operational-state boundaries visible and testable without converting static source evidence into a live provider, deployment, or release claim.

nonGoals: Reading or mutating the personal marketplace.
Adding provider credentials, live provider calls, or external activation.
Writing to the protected default branch.
Treating static source evidence as browser, screen-reader, provider, or release proof.

rounds.name: State-boundary foundation
rounds.objective: Close the Command Center's four missing static state markers with accessible, no-key, non-live UI copy and evidence.

rounds.name: Interaction and recovery semantics
rounds.objective: Strengthen static interaction, focus, and recovery evidence for the new boundary surface without inventing remote behavior.

rounds.name: Public evidence and contract clarity
rounds.objective: Make source, generated artifacts, documentation, and public-distribution terminology agree without turning local evidence into release proof.

rounds.name: Next capability selection
rounds.objective: Select at most one non-duplicative public plugin capability from audited evidence; do not create a card solely to inflate the catalog.

rounds.name: Release-quality handoff
rounds.objective: Finish Wave 1 with current validation, public-safe documentation, focused commits, and feature-branch delivery.
